run_failfast_unittest: run the googletest fail_fast unit test suite to verify fail-fast behavior with different flags and env vars
test_failfast_flag: test the gtest_fail_fast command line flag to stop test execution after the first failure
test_failfast_env_var: test the GTEST_FAIL_FAST environment variable to control fail-fast behavior in Google Test
test_failfast_bazel_env_var: test the TESTBRIDGE_TEST_RUNNER_FAIL_FAST Bazel environment variable to control fail-fast defaults
test_failfast_flag_overrides_env: test that the gtest_fail_fast command line flag takes precedence over the GTEST_FAIL_FAST environment variable
